intro: Jordan is a constitutional monarchy where the king holds wide powers.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The king appoints the prime minister and the Senate and can dissolve parliament. Voters elect the House of Representatives. Jordan is seen as a stable country in a troubled region.

chapters.title: A role in the region
text: Jordan is the official custodian of Muslim and Christian holy sites in Jerusalem and works closely with Western and Gulf countries.
